mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (indicating deteriorating labor market conditions) leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST > 1100 and RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: In periods when the CPI index exceeds 240 (indicating elevated price levels), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 days due to fears of persistent inflation and subsequent monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to deteriorating supply conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 16500 (billions of chained 2017 dollars) signals strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 16500.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment and decrease in unemployment signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 144000 and UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 1100), rising housing starts boost consumer confidence and construction sector activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1100.
